os: windows (helper is PowerShell); proxy is portable
can_disable_login_prompt_note: The proxy has no login, telemetry or update check; the client uses its static-key path.

telemetry_controls.effect: The proxy has no telemetry, update check or request logging; it prints nothing and never logs tokens.

auth.method: Replaces Authorization, x-api-key and api-key from the client with Authorization: Bearer <jwt> obtained from a helper command (30 s limit); token reused until within --margin-s (default 300) of expiry; one forced refresh and retry on upstream 401; HTTP 502 with the helper's message when the helper fails
auth.notes: Optional --local-key requires clients to send that key (x-api-key, api-key or bearer). Binds 127.0.0.1 only (fixed in source). GET /_proxy/health returns {"ok": true, "token_fetches": n}. Streams SSE; passes content encoding through; redirects not followed; request body limit 64 MB. Any local process that can reach the port uses the user's token.

api_formats: any HTTP API; request path and query are appended to --upstream
model_discovery_endpoint_behaviour: not applicable (requests are forwarded unchanged apart from authentication headers)

config_snippets.content:
# Prints ONLY the raw JWT to stdout; on any problem prints a one-line reason to stderr and exits 1.
# Failing fast matters: both Claude Code and Codex retry hard on a bad token.
$Scope       = 'api://<apim-app-id>/.default'
$ExpectedAud = @('api://<apim-app-id>', '<apim-app-client-id>')   # accept both token forms
$MinLifeSecs = 60

$lines = & az account get-access-token --scope $Scope --query accessToken -o tsv 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: az failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE). Run: az login"); exit 1 }

# Tolerate banners/warnings on stdout: keep only the line that looks like a JWT.
$jwt = $lines | ForEach-Object { "$_".Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+$' } | Select-Object -Last 1
if (-not $jwt) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('get-apim-token: az output contained no JWT'); exit 1 }

# Sanity-check the claims so a wrong audience or nearly-expired token fails here, not as an endless 401 loop.
$p = $jwt.Split('.')[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/')
while ($p.Length % 4) { $p += '=' }
$claims = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($p)) | ConvertFrom-Json
$now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()
if ($ExpectedAud -notcontains $claims.aud) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token aud is '$($claims.aud)', expected '$($ExpectedAud -join "' or '")'"); exit 1 }
if ($claims.exp - $now -lt $MinLifeSecs) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token expires in $($claims.exp - $now)s"); exit 1 }

[Console]::Out.Write($jwt)

hosts_default: Entra endpoints through the helper when a token is needed
hosts_after_config: Entra endpoints through the helper when a token is needed
limits: Any process that can reach 127.0.0.1 on the port can use the user's token; shared hosts share the loopback interface.
The gateway cannot distinguish clients; one token for all.
The client must accept a dummy key.
HTTP to the proxy is plain text on loopback only.
HTTPS to a real gateway through the proxy and the --local-key option have no run-time confirmation yet.
verification_status: verified: key replacement, SSE pass-through, retry on upstream 401, 502 on helper failure and recovery, use by Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot Chat. Not verified: HTTPS upstream, --local-key, JetBrains.
